'''2004 European Championship David Destefanis DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[David Destefanis]] at [[2004 European Championship]]; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by David "Lirkas 'DDM'" Destefanis (2004-11-19).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34073 EC 2004 deck Hyper Solid Deal Europe]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20061110042827/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34073&PHPSESSID=29818f8b6da266174ddd746571e9b090 Internet Archive]</ref>
